messages:
maria: quick follow-up from the RFC — saw a customer burst this morning where our billing events ballooned and late credits doubled. thinking we need a light-touch retrofit for surge smoothing so audits don't explode.

jonathan: ugh, saw that alert. audit spike correlates with a retry storm + a slow downstream shard. the meter ingester got overwhelmed and started emitting duplicates.

eng-platform-lead: can you sketch a minimal mitigation? we should avoid big schema changes right now.

maria: proposal: implement a soft-lease extension on token claims + a short-term adaptive throttle at ingress. idea is to increase lease TTL by 2-3x during detected backpressure, so retried requests coalesce instead of re-creating new credit entries. no data model changes, just behavior at the handshake layer.

jonathan: sounds promising. how do we detect backpressure? CPU queue length, kafka lag, or an explicit 503 rate from downstream?

maria: hybrid: if downstream 503 or consumer lag > X for > Y seconds, mark tenant as 'surge' and apply smoothing policy. default window 30s.

leo: curious about audit correctness — won't extending leases hide legitimate parallel usage? e.g., two concurrent legitimate calls that should both charge.

maria: good point. keep the lease semantics: extension only applies to idempotent-handshakes where request fingerprint matches OR when request contains the same root usage id. we only coalesce when provenance indicates it's likely a retry. otherwise we fall back to normal accounting.

sarah: how do we identify 'same root usage id' in streaming vs chunked requests? we have multiple existing patterns.

jonathan: suggest adding a lightweight provenance header we can synthesize at gateway if not present: X-Usage-Root: <fingerprint>. we already have fingerprinting in tokenizer — can reuse. no schema change to ledger entries; header is used only by the handshake to decide dedupe.

eng-platform-lead: ok but ops will need visibility. can ops-bot emit metrics when smoothing is active per tenant? we need to audit how often leases were extended for billing disputes.

ops-bot: alert configured: "smoothing_active" metric emitted with tenant_id tag when smoothing is toggled. logs include sample of request fingerprints for post-mortem. :gear:

maria: also propose a short grace-period reconcile job: every minute, a reconciler scans smoothing events and emits audit entries with a "smoothing_hint" flag so downstream billing can still surface to customers. not a full replay, just an annotation.

leo: tradeoff: that reconciler adds latency to final audit visibility. customers might see delayed line items. acceptable?

maria: yes — plan is to surface provisional tokens immediately and mark them provisional until reconcile finishes. customers see provisional usage but final charge waits on reconcile. we already have notion of provisional vs finalized in billing UI.

jonathan: edge-case: what about cross-region hedged requests that touch different ingest clusters? fingerprints need to be canonical (hash over request + tenant + timestamp window). otherwise smoothing could fail.

maria: agreed. canonical fingerprint spec: sha256(tenant + root-id + normalized-payload) truncated to 16 chars; gateway normalizes whitespace and ordering for structured inputs. add spec to RFC follow-up doc.

sarah: can we deploy this as a staged rollout? maybe start with 0.1% tenants, then 1%, then broader.

eng-platform-lead: yes, do canary by tenant percentage and add a kill-switch. also add a metric for "provisional_to_final_delta" so finance can alert if smoothing materially changes revenue timing.

maria: action items: 1) jonathan: implement soft-lease extension + detection (PR for handshake logic) 2) leo: add canonical fingerprint util in gateway service 3) sarah: rollout plan and observability dashboard 4) ops-bot: wire smoothing_active metric 5) i'll write the RFC appendix with canonical fingerprint and reconciliation contract. LMK blockers.

jonathan: sg, I'll put up a draft PR with unit tests and a simple feature flag.

leo: will add util and tests.

sarah: will draft rollout doc, include customer comms note for delayed finalization.

eng-platform-lead: sounds good. schedule a 30m sync tomorrow if PRs are ready. thanks all. :thumbsup:
